data.desc: Founded in 2007, Baozun Inc. is a leader in brand e-commerce service, brand management, and digital commerce service. Baozun Inc. comprises three major business lines - Baozun e-Commerce (BEC), Baozun Brand Management (BBM) and Baozun International (BZI) - and is committed to accelerating high-quality and sustainable growth. Driven by the principle that 'Technology Empowers the Future Success', Baozun's business lines are devoted to empowering their clients' business and navigating their new phase of development.
